profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Eager, highly dependable Software Engineer with thorough hands-on experience in various levels of testing, including functional, unit, instrumentation and end to end testing. Supportive and enthusiastic team player with the desire to continuously improve and expand skill set.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Worked primarily as a horizontal test team that builds test infrastructure and tools for partner teams such as Bing, XBOX, and Windows Phone. Develop an Interactive SDK in C# for the Bing Maps API. Worked with the XBOX One team to build test automation that verifies conversational understanding responses from the server using Microsoft TAEF. Built end to end test automation for Windows Phone Cortana. Built end to end test automation for Bing Maps Desktop Website using an internal testing framework built on Selenium. Worked on developing features for the new Bing Maps Website

positions.title: Intern
positions.description: Developed software that allows users to connect to a telescope and easily track planets and stars.

positions.title: Worker
positions.description: Served food to customers. Cleaned tables. Worked as cashier taking customer orders.

projects.title: CourtWriter - ESPN ALPS competition
projects.description:
Scorekeepers just simply type what they see. All a user has to do is type what they see happen on the basketball court and the statistics will be recorded.  This is much faster than going through a bunch of user forms.  All it takes is one click for the court location!  The rest is handled by typing!

Technologies used - C#, Visual Studio
